I found Eve's body in lower engine just now. Here's my route: I started at weapons, went to security, then electrical, medbay, upper engine, and finally lower engine where I found Eve dead.

Along the way I saw Charlie in electrical around ticks 8-10 — they came in from medbay. Then I saw Diana in upper engine from ticks 17-19, she came in from medbay too.

So both Charlie and Diana have partial alibis with me as a witness. I never saw Frank this whole round, and apparently Frank is also dead. That makes me suspicious of whoever was unaccounted for — I'd like to hear from Charlie and Diana about where they went after I last saw them, and especially whether anyone saw Frank or was near medbay/lower engine recently.

I was mostly on the bottom right and right side of the map this round. I went through storage, headed up to security, and just got into weapons right at the end where I saw Charlie when the meeting was called. I didn't go over to the left side (upper/lower engine) at all, so I unfortunately didn't see Frank or Eve. 

Bob, since you found the body in lower engine, and Diana was in upper engine around ticks 17-19, Diana might be our best source of info. Diana, did you see anyone heading down to lower engine or coming up from there while you were in upper engine?

Okay, here's my route: I started in oxygen, then went upper engine, medbay, electrical, security, and ended in weapons where Alice just joined me.

I can confirm part of Bob's story — I was in electrical around ticks 8-10 and Bob was there with me. I saw him leave electrical heading to medbay at tick 10, which matches what he said.

I also saw Eve alive in upper engine at ticks 2-4, so she was alive early on. And importantly, I saw Diana in electrical too — she came in from security at tick 11 and then left to medbay at tick 11. So Diana was moving through electrical right after Bob left.

One thing that's bugging me about Bob's story: Bob says he saw Diana in upper engine ticks 17-19 coming from medbay. That's consistent with Diana going medbay -> upper engine -> ??? Lower engine is right below upper engine. Diana could have gone down to lower engine after Bob left her in upper engine.

But also — Bob himself ended up in lower engine and "found" the body. Bob's path electrical -> medbay -> upper engine -> lower engine puts him right at the crime scene. He could be the killer reporting his own kill.

I'm honestly torn between Bob and Diana. I'd like to hear Diana's account before voting. Diana, where did you go after upper engine?

Okay, let me lay out my route clearly: I went security -> weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay -> upper engine, and I stayed in upper engine until the meeting was called. I did NOT go to lower engine at any point.

I can confirm Charlie's story — I saw Charlie in electrical at tick 11, which matches their account of being in electrical and then moving on. 

I can also confirm Bob was with me in upper engine ticks 17-19, and I witnessed Bob coming from medbay into upper engine at tick 14 — wait, let me be precise: I saw Bob enter upper engine from medbay around tick 14, and he was with me through 17-19. 

But here's the problem with Bob's story: Bob claimed he went electrical -> medbay -> upper engine -> lower engine. If Bob arrived in upper engine around tick 14 and was there with me through tick 19, then he left upper engine after tick 19 and went DOWN to lower engine, where he immediately "found" Eve's body and called the meeting. That's a very short window — he basically walked into lower engine and found a body instantly.

Charlie is confirmed by me in electrical at tick 11. I'm confirmed by Bob in upper engine 17-19. Bob is the only one whose final movement took him to the crime scene, and neither Charlie nor I can vouch for what he did before electrical or after he left me.

I'm voting Bob. Charlie, I'd back you up here.

Wait, I already spoke first — but I need to respond to Diana's accusation because she's twisting the timeline.

Diana, your logic actually points AT you, not me. Think about it: you say I entered upper engine at tick 14 and stayed with you until tick 19, then went to lower engine and "instantly" found a body. Yes — because lower engine is right below upper engine, it's a 2-tick trip. I walked in and Eve was already dead there. Someone killed her BEFORE I arrived.

Now who had the opportunity? You said your route was security -> weapons -> security -> electrical -> medbay -> upper engine. But Charlie placed you in electrical at tick 11 coming from security, and you went medbay -> upper engine arriving at tick 17. That's a big gap — ticks 11 to 17 — six ticks between electrical and arriving in upper engine. Medbay to upper engine is only 2 ticks. Where were you for the other 4 ticks? Medbay connects directly to lower engine (2 ticks). You had time to detour: medbay -> lower engine -> kill Eve -> back up through medbay or upper engine.

Meanwhile I was with Charlie in electrical 8-10, then moved medbay -> upper engine, arriving at 17 same as you. I had no window to detour to lower engine before finding the body.

Charlie, check Diana's timing — the gap between her leaving electrical at 11 and arriving in upper engine at 17 is the suspicious window. I'm voting Diana.

Bob makes a fair point about timing, but honestly, walking straight down into lower engine and immediately finding a body is incredibly suspicious. As Charlie pointed out, it feels very much like a self-report where you just happen to be the one who "finds" the victim at the end of your route. 

Since Diana is confident and Charlie already raised the same concern about your final movement, I think Bob is the most likely suspect here. I'm voting Bob.

Okay, I've been thinking carefully about Bob's response, and I need to revisit my own observations.

Bob raised a real point about Diana's timing gap. Let me check it: Diana left electrical at tick 11 heading to medbay. Medbay to upper engine is 2 ticks, so she could have been in upper engine by tick 13-14. But Bob says he saw her in upper engine 17-19, and Diana says she arrived around tick 17. That's a 4-6 tick gap unaccounted for. Medbay-to-lower-engine is 2 ticks, so a detour medbay -> lower engine -> back is very possible in that window.

On the other hand, Bob's path electrical (left at 10) -> medbay -> upper engine arriving 14 — that's 4 ticks for what should be a 4-tick journey (2+2). So Bob's timing is tight and accounted for. Then he was with Diana 14-19 in upper engine, then went down to lower engine and found Eve.

Here's the key: Bob CAN'T have killed Eve before arriving in upper engine because his timing is tight. And he was with Diana from 14-19. So if Eve was killed in lower engine, it had to be by someone with a window to be there — and Diana's gap fits that perfectly.

I'm changing my read. Diana's gap between tick 11 and tick 17 is the suspicious window. Bob's accounted for. I'm voting Diana.

Wait — I already spoke. But since I'm listed as speaker 4, let me make my final case because Bob and Charlie are now ganging up on me with a flawed timeline.

Bob is misrepresenting my timing. Yes, I was in electrical at tick 11 — Charlie saw me. Then I went to medbay. Medbay to upper engine is 2 ticks. But I didn't go straight there — I was DOING MY TASK in medbay. I'm a Goose with tasks, and medbay is on my task list. That accounts for the "gap" Bob is trying to weaponize against me.

More importantly: Bob's own timing is what's suspicious. He claims he left electrical at tick 10, went medbay -> upper engine, arriving tick 14. But I witnessed Bob coming from medbay into upper engine at tick 14 — and he stayed with me until 19. Then he goes DIRECTLY to lower engine and "finds" Eve. That's textbook self-report behavior.

Charlie, think about this carefully: Bob is the one steering this whole conversation. He spoke first to frame the narrative, named me and you as "partial alibis" to seem helpful, and now he's pivoting hard to me the moment I called him out. That's classic Duck behavior.

The body was in lower engine. Bob is the ONLY person who admits being in lower engine. I never went there. If I had detoured to lower engine, I'd have to explain how I got back up — and the cleanest path back is through upper engine, where Bob would have seen me arrive from below, not from medbay. But Bob himself said I came from medbay.

I'm sticking with my vote: Bob.

My route this round: navigation, then storage, then medbay, then cafeteria. I called this meeting because I need us to talk before one of us ends up dead.

Here's my concern: Diana got voted out last meeting, but Eve and Frank both died after that - well, Eve was already dead, but Frank died this round. If Diana was innocent, then Bob, you're the Duck. I've been doing tasks - navigation, storage tasks, medbay.

Hold on Charlie, your story has some serious problems.

First, you said you saw me "enter cafeteria from medbay at tick 32" — that's actually true, I went storage -> lower engine -> storage -> medbay -> cafeteria. So that part checks out.

But you said you saw me in electrical at tick 9. That's a lie. At tick 8, 9, and 10 I saw YOU in electrical — I was passing through or near there. I was never in electrical doing tasks. You're trying to flip the script on me.

Also — Diana. I saw Diana in upper engine at ticks 17, 18, and 19, clearly doing the engine task. She was acting like a real Goose. We voted her out last meeting based on me reporting Eve and Frank's bodies, and honestly I'm now worried we made a mistake.

I think you're the Duck, Charlie. I'm voting you.

Uh, Charlie, I'm still alive over here! Not sure why you completely forgot about me, but I've been quietly doing my tasks on the left side of the map — went from security to weapons, then through cafeteria down to upper and lower engine. 

It's actually really suspicious that you tried to frame this as just a 1v1 between you and Bob. Bob makes a very compelling point about your timeline not adding up, especially with you lying about seeing him in electrical. Plus, since Bob was the one who reported the bodies last meeting, I'm definitely inclined to trust him more here.

I think Charlie is trying to pull a fast one on us. I'm voting Charlie.

Wait — Alice, you're absolutely right, I apologize. I genuinely thought it was just me and Bob left based on the alive count I was tracking, but clearly I was wrong. That's my mistake, not deception.

But let me address Bob's accusation directly. I stand by what I said — I saw Bob in electrical at tick 9. I was passing through that area on my route. Bob is now claiming I was in electrical at ticks 8, 9, and 10, but my route was navigation -> storage -> medbay -> cafeteria. I was nowhere near electrical at tick 9 doing tasks. Bob is fabricating that to discredit me.

Here's what's important: Frank died THIS round, after Diana was ejected. So Diana was innocent, and the Duck is still among us three. Alice, you say you went security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> upper engine -> lower engine. I never saw you anywhere on my route, which is plausible since we were on opposite sides.

Bob, however, I DID see in electrical at tick 9, and then again entering cafeteria from medbay at tick 32. Medbay is adjacent to a lot of rooms where bodies could've been dropped.

I'm not the Duck. I called this meeting because I was worried. I think Bob is our Duck — he reported the bodies last meeting (classic Duck move to control the narrative) and now he's flipping my observation to frame me.

Alright, let me be crystal clear because this is critical.

My route this round was: storage -> lower engine -> storage -> medbay -> cafeteria. I have task records to back that up.

I saw Charlie in ELECTRICAL at ticks 8, 9, AND 10. Three consecutive ticks. He was sitting there, not just passing through. Charlie now claims his route was "navigation -> storage -> medbay -> cafeteria" — notice electrical is NOT on that list. So either he's lying about his route now, or he was lying when he said he saw me in electrical at tick 9 (because HE was the one there, not me).

Also important: I saw Diana in upper engine at ticks 17, 18, 19 — clearly doing the engine task like a real Goose. We made a mistake ejecting her last meeting, and that mistake is on me for calling the meeting, but the bodies were real.

Frank died THIS round after Diana was ejected. That confirms Diana was innocent and the Duck is still alive. Between me, Alice, and Charlie:
- Alice's route (security -> weapons -> cafeteria -> engines) is on the opposite side from where I was, consistent.
- Charlie's route has a hole — he was in electrical for at least 3 ticks and is now denying it while trying to put ME there.

Charlie is the Duck. I'm voting Charlie.

Bob, you're making complete sense, and Charlie's inconsistencies are glaring. First, Charlie entirely forgot I was even in the game, which felt like a rushed attempt to force a 1v1 narrative before I could weigh in. On top of that, as you pointed out, Charlie's timeline regarding electrical is full of holes, and his story keeps shifting depending on who's accusing him. 

Since Bob reported the bodies last round and has kept his story straight, while Charlie is scrambling to deflect, I have no doubt Charlie is our Duck trying to talk his way out of a corner. I'm locking in my vote for Charlie. Let's finish this.
